design_evaluation.summary: A polished personal tech-hub site with strong dark/light theming, a clear hero hierarchy, and well-structured overlays (login modal, chat consent panel, mobile menu). Main weaknesses are small low-contrast metadata labels, absent visible focus/ARIA affordances in the captured states, and a floating Voice Agent button that overlaps card content on mobile.
strengths: Hero establishes clear hierarchy: large two-tone headline ('AI Testing & Integration. / Building Trust.') with gradient accent, supporting paragraph, stats bar, and distinct primary (Live Feed) vs secondary (AI Lab) CTAs.
Theme toggle produces a coherent light variant: navigation, hero, code window, and AI TEST RESULT card all adapt colors and remain legible; icon switches from gear/sun to moon state appropriately.

Login modal is well-structured: dimmed backdrop, centered dialog, clear Email/Password labels with placeholder text, Login/Register tabs with an active-tab underline indicator, visible close (×) button, and a 'Forgot password?' recovery link.

Chat panel opens with a responsible consent gate ('Before we start' disclaimer, agreement checkbox, and a visibly muted 'Agree & Start Chat' button implying disabled state until consent), plus labeled 'AI' badge on the bot toggle.
Mobile menu presents all primary nav items (Feed, Explore, Tools, Challenge, Digest, Break it) stacked with generous tap-target spacing and a close (×) affordance.
Terminal mockup (playwright.config.ts) and AI TEST RESULT card use status color-coding (green 'Passed', orange 'Warning', PASS badge) that reinforces meaning beyond text alone.
issues: Low-contrast metadata labels: 'ARTICLES TODAY', 'RSS SOURCES', 'AUTO-UPDATED' and card body text (e.g., 'Stress-test your AI...') sit at low opacity on dark backgrounds; 'Building Trust.' pink gradient may fall short of contrast on the light theme background.
No visible focus indicators are demonstrated in any captured state (nav links, modal inputs, checkbox, Agree button), so keyboard accessibility cues cannot be confirmed.
In the mobile-menu screenshot, the floating Voice Agent button and bot icon overlap the 'Adversarial Simulation' card, partially obscuring its 'Explore →' link and body text.

In the mobile-menu screenshot, the first stat in the stats bar is clipped behind the menu overlay (only '7 RSS SOURCES' and '24/7' fully visible), suggesting the overlay allows background content to sit in an ambiguous half-visible state.
The 'Break it' nav item is visually prominent (red pill) but its purpose is not self-explanatory from the label alone; no tooltip or description is visible.

Card footer actions use varied verbs ('Explore', 'Scan', 'Verify', 'Check') — playful but slightly inconsistent for a repeated card pattern; a shared affordance style or clearer destination hint would improve predictability.
In the chat-open screenshot, the consent text and checkbox row are quite small (checkbox appears ~14px), which risks tap-target and readability issues on touch devices.

The documented status-code contract is therefore violated: a client relying on HTTP status will treat this denial as success. The security rule holds; the API contract does not.
